mapper.select: SELECT res.finish_status AS finishStatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `result` res INNER JOIN registration reg ON res.registration_id = reg.id WHERE reg.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY res.finish_status
SELECT rn.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM registration reg INNER JOIN runner rn ON reg.runner_id = rn.id WHERE reg.event_id = #{eventId} AND reg.status = 1 GROUP BY rn.gender
